aspect_scores.evidence: Most guests found rooms clean or spotless, but others reported a musty smell, damp carpet, mold and a room not properly cleaned.
Front desk staff were often described as warm, friendly and helpful, but some guests reported slow check-in, an unanswered phone and no action on a noise complaint.
Opinions split: praise for cinnamon rolls, pastries and coffee, against complaints of packaged muffins, few hot options, running out of food and minimal choice.
Beds were generally comfortable, though rooms were called dated or tired and two guests had heater problems.
One guest found it great value for a harbor town in season, another found it disappointing for the price.
The harbor and waterfront location, walkable to docks, marina and dining, is a consistent strength.
Several guests found rooms quiet, while others heard the hallway through thin walls or had noisy neighbors late at night.
Parking is limited, with few spots for the size of the inn.
Wifi dropped in the evening and was slow for work calls.
The lobby coffee was a welcome touch.

serious_issues.quote: The bathroom had mold in the corner.

actions.title: Add a room inspection checklist to housekeeping routines
actions.why: Most guests found rooms spotless, but review 14 found trash left in the bin and others reported mold and mustiness, so cleaning quality is inconsistent.

actions.title: Inspect and remediate mold and damp in affected bathrooms and carpets
actions.why: Review 5 reported mold in the bathroom corner and review 2 a musty smell and damp carpet, a health issue behind the 3 of 5 cleanliness score.

actions.title: Expand breakfast with hot items and restock before 8 am
actions.why: Breakfast scored 2 of 5, with complaints of packaged muffins, few hot options and running out of food, while the cinnamon rolls and pastries were praised.

actions.title: Set front desk standards for phone answering and noise complaints
actions.why: Guests reported an unanswered desk phone, slow check-in and no action on late-night noise, despite warm staff overall.

actions.title: Service and replace faulty room heaters before the cold season
actions.why: Reviews 8 and 17 report a rattling heater and a heater that did not work on a cold night, and staff could not move the guest.

authenticity.note: Each flag is a signal for review, not a verdict. Confirm keeps its reviews out of the verified rating and the synthesis; dismiss returns them.

flags.rationale: 5 reviews share near duplicate phrasing: peak Jaccard similarity 0.92 (mean 0.79) against a threshold of 0.55.
5 5-star reviews posted within 2 days (2026-06-03 to 2026-06-05); threshold is 3 within 4 days.
5 reviews share near duplicate meaning: peak cosine similarity 1.00 (mean 0.99) against a threshold of 0.85; 0 of 10 pairs in the group were not caught by word overlap.
Language resembles reviews written without a stay: p = 0.82 (threshold 0.80). Cues toward deceptive: 'amazing', 'hotel in', 'staff and'; toward truthful: 'michigan', 'in', 'staff'.
Language resembles reviews written without a stay: p = 0.82 (threshold 0.80). Cues toward deceptive: 'amazing', 'hotel in', 'staff and'; toward truthful: 'michigan', 'by', 'in'.

thresholds.duplicate_phrasing: Jaccard word overlap at or above 0.55
thresholds.rating_burst: 3 or more same rating reviews within 4 days
thresholds.claim_duplicate: at least 2 shared specific claims, then a model judgment per pair (strict prompt)

methods.flag_decisions_by: automatic: every flag confirmed without review (evaluation run)
